strongest_verified_theorem: On the closed connected product of the smooth genus-two completion of y^2=z^6-1 and C/(Z+iZ), a jointly smooth family J_epsilon equals product J0 outside one fixed coordinate ball, converges to it in C-infinity, retains three fixed independent real de Rham classes with closed anti-invariant representatives, and is nonintegrable for every sufficiently small nonzero real epsilon of either sign. Thus h^- >=3. No exact dimension, fixed-form compatibility, spatial analyticity or historical-priority conclusion is asserted.
